review: Recovery50 short Mac streaming parser validation route

routeAssessment.trigger: one initial created push, run attempt 1, zero before SHA, fixed repository and branch
routeAssessment.monitorAndCleanup: Existing Runner, ABI bindings, owned groups, resource limits, first failure, stopping monitor failure, retained diagnostics, exact leader reap and verified group cleanup are retained.
routeAssessment.preflight: Actual 514 QA plus 14 recording tests must pass with strictly typed zero failures, errors and skips; missing failure or cleanup evidence rejects the final predicate.
routeAssessment.serializerContract: Nine ordered cases are required: the six existing cases and three large whole-profile positive, no-end and truncated controls. Every large input must exceed 16 MiB. Exact count, type, unknown, source and cleanup predicates apply.
routeAssessment.denseInput: The selected source-bound portable test includes 1,000,000 resource rows and requires observed aggregation within the unchanged 30-second budget on the actual Mac.
routeAssessment.individualEvidence: The final public result includes all nine bounded case projections when the complete contract validates. Linux case values must not be substituted for actual Mac observations.
routeAssessment.negativeSemantics: No-end is observed complete coverage with zero ended targets. Truncation stays unconfirmed with null counts. Neither is build completion or cache reuse proof.

resolvedFindings.issue: The inherited driver predicate accepted absent firstFailure, driverFailure, or monitorFailure as None.
resolvedFindings.resolution: All three fields must now be present and explicitly None; missing-field negative controls reject.

resolvedFindings.issue: The inherited preflight predicate accepted an absent stage cleanupFailure as None.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Every stage must now explicitly contain cleanupFailure=None; missing evidence rejects.

preActivationConditions: Recheck the reviewed caller/source identities, unused dedicated branch, no prior caller runs, and no active or queued owned validation immediately before the single activation.
Use the reviewed fixture and caller exactly; this decision covers only the SDK-free short diagnostic.
terminalAcceptance: Provider metadata must bind the actual run and sole Mac job to this caller, source fixture, initial push and attempt 1.
All 514 QA and 14 recording tests must actually pass with zero skips, failures and errors; all owned stages must finish with exact leader reaping and verified cleanup.
The actual nine-case serializer result and final strict predicates must pass. Retain individual large-case values and keep all qualification scopes synthetic.
Verify artifact count zero and preserve any monitor uncertainty or first failure independently.
limits: No actual Mac result is claimed by this prelaunch review.
No lost Recovery48 profile, compiler subphase, remaining duration, cache hit, full build, Mozilla harness or native authentication result is reconstructed or qualified.
The unchanged 2 GiB input cap and cooperative 30-second parser budget are bounds, not a guarantee for every possible profile.
Later authorized continuation should use actual short terminal evidence and fresh legitimate SDK/checkpoint origin checks; an unknown forecast alone is not an indefinite hold.
publicEvidencePrivacy: Reviewed technical documents and new bounded case projections contain no private paths, raw process identifiers, command text, environment values, secret URLs or conversation details.
